name: bun-warmer
description: Keeps the prompt cache warm with a periodic ping, counts subagent work as activity, never blocks a prompt a human did not type, and writes a state file for a close hook. Inspired by cache-tax by Karan Bansal (MIT).

intervalMin.title: Ping interval (minutes)
intervalMin.description: Minutes of quiet before a ping. Default 50; the cache goes cold after 60, so values above 55 are capped. Env BUN_WARMER_INTERVAL_MIN overrides.

windowHours.title: Window (hours)
windowHours.description: How long pings continue after the last human prompt. Default 3. Env BUN_WARMER_WINDOW_HOURS overrides.

guard.title: Cold-send guard
guard.description: warn only shows a note when you type a prompt into a cold session. refuse drops your own first send once. Never applies to subagent or other non-human prompts.
